subject: Business Models
title: Platform Breakups
description: A fast breakdown of Platform Breakups for builders.

hook.text: The US government sued to break up Standard Oil in 1911. Could it do the same to Meta or Google?

buildup.text: Proposals include unwinding Meta's acquisitions of Instagram and WhatsApp to restore competition.

discovery.text: AT&T's 1984 breakup created competition that drove phone prices down and innovation up.

twist.text: Platform breakups may not work like industrial ones. Splitting a network in half destroys its value.

climax.text: The debate continues: are platform monopolies natural and efficient, or anticompetitive and harmful?

punchline.text: Split a network, destroy the value. Breaking up platforms is harder.

quiz.question: Why might breaking up a platform be different from breaking up an industrial monopoly?
options: Splitting a network destroys its core value
